problem:
Consider the polynomials ${p}_{1}(t)$ and ${p}_{2}(t),$ given by

$$
{p}_{1}(t)=1-t+2{t}^{2},\,{p}_{2}(t)=t-{t}^{2}.
$$

Find $p(t)$ given that $B={{p}_{1}(t),{p}_{2}(t)}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{p}_{1},{p}_{2}},$ and the coordinates of $p(t)$ relative to $B$ are $[p(t)]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$

activity_context.topic_title: The Coordinates of a Vector Relative to a Basis in Abstract Vector Spaces
